$comment: Floors for the response-coverage numbers in scripts/e2e/hub_response_coverage.py, the same data as the weekly Slack report. The Hub invariant 'response coverage does not regress' runs the script and fails if an asserted per-status-code total, the request-check, fully-asserted or optional-field number is lower than its floor, or if an operation has no test at all that is not listed in zeroTestOperations with the reason. A floor is one-way: a PR that closes a gap should raise it, but a higher number never fails. Do not lower a floor to make CI pass; add the missing test.

zeroTestOperations.reason: Excluded under camunda-hub#26448 (ProblemDetail missing `type` on framework-level validation errors) and unchainable (camunda-hub#25907).
